label: 2 Corinthians 1:1
text: Paul, an apostle of mine by the will of my Father, and Timothy, a brother, unto the church of mine which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:

label: 2 Corinthians 1:2
text: Grace be to you and peace from my Father, and from me.

label: 2 Corinthians 1:3
text: Blessed be my Father, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;

label: 2 Corinthians 1:4
text: Who comforteth him in all his tribulation, that he may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith he himself is comforted of my Father.

label: 2 Corinthians 1:5
text: For as my sufferings abound in him, so his consolation also aboundeth by me.

label: 2 Corinthians 1:6
text: And whether he be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which he also suffereth: or whether he be comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.

label: 2 Corinthians 1:7
text: And his hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.

label: 2 Corinthians 1:8
text: For he would not, brethren, have you ignorant of his trouble which came to him in Asia, that he was pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that he despaired even of life:

label: 2 Corinthians 1:9
text: But he had the sentence of death in himself, that he should not trust in himself, but in me, who raise the dead:

label: 2 Corinthians 1:10
text: I delivered him from so great a death, and do deliver: in me he trusteth that I will yet deliver him;

label: 2 Corinthians 1:11
text: Ye also helping together by prayer for him, that for the gift bestowed upon him by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on his behalf.

label: 2 Corinthians 1:12
text: For his rejoicing is this, the testimony of his conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of my Father, he hath had his conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.

label: 2 Corinthians 1:13
text: For he writeth none other things unto you, than what ye read or acknowledge; and he trusteth ye shall acknowledge even to the end;

label: 2 Corinthians 1:14
text: As also ye have acknowledged him in part, that he is your rejoicing, even as ye also are his in my day.

label: 2 Corinthians 1:15
text: And in this confidence he was minded to come unto you before, that ye might have a second benefit;

label: 2 Corinthians 1:16
text: And to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia unto you, and of you to be brought on his way toward Judea.

label: 2 Corinthians 1:17
text: When he therefore was thus minded, did he use lightness? or the things that he purposeth, doth he purpose according to the flesh, that with him there should be yea yea, and nay nay?

label: 2 Corinthians 1:18
text: But as my Father is true, his word toward you was not yea and nay.

label: 2 Corinthians 1:19
text: For I, the Son of God, who was preached among you by them, even by Paul and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yea and nay, but in me was yea.

label: 2 Corinthians 1:20
text: For all the promises of my Father in me are yea, and in me Amen, unto the glory of my Father by them.

label: 2 Corinthians 1:21
text: Now it is my Father which stablisheth him with you in me, and hath anointed him.

label: 2 Corinthians 1:22
text: Who hath also sealed you, and given the earnest of the Spirit in your hearts.

label: 2 Corinthians 1:23
text: Moreover he calleth my Father for a record upon his soul, that to spare you he came not as yet unto Corinth.

label: 2 Corinthians 1:24
text: Not for that he hath dominion over your faith, but is a helper of your joy: for by faith ye stand.

label: 2 Corinthians 2:1
text: But he determined this with himself, that he would not come again to you in heaviness.

label: 2 Corinthians 2:2
text: For if he make you sorry, who is he then that maketh him glad, but the same which is made sorry by him?

label: 2 Corinthians 2:3
text: And he wrote this same unto you, lest, when he came, he should have sorrow from them of whom he ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that his joy is the joy of you all.

label: 2 Corinthians 2:4
text: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart he wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be grieved, but that ye might know the love which he hath more abundantly unto you.

label: 2 Corinthians 2:5
text: But if any have caused grief, he hath not grieved him, but in part: that he may not overcharge you all.

label: 2 Corinthians 2:6
text: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.

label: 2 Corinthians 2:7
text: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.

label: 2 Corinthians 2:8
text: Wherefore he beseecheth you that ye would confirm your love toward him.

label: 2 Corinthians 2:9
text: For to this end also did he write, that he might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.

label: 2 Corinthians 2:10
text: To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in mine own person;

label: 2 Corinthians 2:11
text: Lest Satan should get an advantage of you: for ye are not ignorant of his devices.

label: 2 Corinthians 2:12
text: Furthermore, when he came to Troas to preach my gospel, and a door was opened unto him of me,

label: 2 Corinthians 2:13
text: He had no rest in his spirit, because he found not Titus his brother: but taking his leave of them, he went from thence into Macedonia.

label: 2 Corinthians 2:14
text: Now thanks be unto my Father, which always causeth you to triumph in me, and maketh manifest the savour of my knowledge by you in every place.

label: 2 Corinthians 2:15
text: For ye are unto my Father a sweet savour of mine, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:

label: 2 Corinthians 2:16
text: To the one ye are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?

label: 2 Corinthians 2:17
text: For ye are not as many, which corrupt my word: but as of sincerity, but as of my Father, in the sight of my Father speak ye in me.

label: 2 Corinthians 3:1
text: Doth he begin again to commend himself? or needeth he, as some others, epistles of commendation to you, or letters of commendation from you?

label: 2 Corinthians 3:2
text: Ye are his epistle written in his heart, known and read of all men:

label: 2 Corinthians 3:3
text: Forasmuch as ye are manifestly declared to be mine epistle ministered by him, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.

label: 2 Corinthians 3:4
text: And such trust hath he through me toward my Father:

label: 2 Corinthians 3:5
text: Not that he is sufficient of himself to think any thing as of himself; but his sufficiency is of my Father;

label: 2 Corinthians 3:6
text: Who also hath made you able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.

label: 2 Corinthians 3:7
text: But if the ministration of death, written and engraven in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away:

label: 2 Corinthians 3:8
text: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?

label: 2 Corinthians 3:9
text: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.

label: 2 Corinthians 3:10
text: For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect, by reason of the glory that excelleth.

label: 2 Corinthians 3:11
text: For if that which is done away was glorious, much more that which remaineth is glorious.

label: 2 Corinthians 3:12
text: Seeing then that ye have such hope, ye use great plainness of speech:

label: 2 Corinthians 3:13
text: And not as Moses, which put a vail over his face, that the children of Israel could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished:

label: 2 Corinthians 3:14
text: But their minds were blinded: for until this day remaineth the same vail untaken away in the reading of the old testament; which vail is done away in me.

label: 2 Corinthians 3:15
text: But even unto this day, when Moses is read, the vail is upon their heart.

label: 2 Corinthians 3:16
text: Nevertheless when it shall turn to me, the vail shall be taken away.

label: 2 Corinthians 3:17
text: Now I am that Spirit: and where my Spirit is, there is liberty.

label: 2 Corinthians 3:18
text: But ye all, with open face beholding as in a glass my glory, are changed into my image from glory to glory, even as by my Spirit.

label: 2 Corinthians 4:1
text: Therefore seeing ye have this ministry, as ye have received mercy, ye faint not;

label: 2 Corinthians 4:2
text: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling my word deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending yourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of my Father.

label: 2 Corinthians 4:3
text: But if my gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:

label: 2 Corinthians 4:4
text: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of my glorious gospel, even I, the image of my Father, should shine unto them.

label: 2 Corinthians 4:5
text: For he preacheth not himself, but me; and himself your servant for my sake.

label: 2 Corinthians 4:6
text: For my Father, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in your hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of my glory in my face.

label: 2 Corinthians 4:7
text: But ye have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of my Father, and not of you.

label: 2 Corinthians 4:8
text: Ye are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; ye are perplexed, but not in despair;

label: 2 Corinthians 4:9
text: Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;

label: 2 Corinthians 4:10
text: Always bearing about in the body my dying, that my life also might be made manifest in your body.

label: 2 Corinthians 4:11
text: For ye which live are alway delivered unto death for my sake, that my life also might be made manifest in your mortal flesh.

label: 2 Corinthians 4:12
text: So then death worketh in him, but life in you.

label: 2 Corinthians 4:13
text: He having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; he also believeth, and therefore speaketh;

label: 2 Corinthians 4:14
text: Knowing that my Father which raised up me shall raise up him also by me, and shall present him with you.

label: 2 Corinthians 4:15
text: For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of my Father.

label: 2 Corinthians 4:16
text: For which cause ye faint not; but though your outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.

label: 2 Corinthians 4:17
text: For your light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for you a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;

label: 2 Corinthians 4:18
text: While ye look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.

label: 2 Corinthians 5:1
text: For ye know that if your earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, ye have a building of my Father, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.

label: 2 Corinthians 5:2
text: For in this ye groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with your house which is from heaven:

label: 2 Corinthians 5:3
text: If so be that being clothed ye shall not be found naked.

label: 2 Corinthians 5:4
text: For ye that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that ye would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.

label: 2 Corinthians 5:5
text: Now he that hath wrought you for the selfsame thing is my Father, who also hath given unto you the earnest of the Spirit.

label: 2 Corinthians 5:6
text: Therefore ye are always confident, knowing that, whilst ye are at home in the body, ye are absent from me:

label: 2 Corinthians 5:7
text: (For ye walk by faith, not by sight:)

label: 2 Corinthians 5:8
text: Ye are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with me.

label: 2 Corinthians 5:9
text: Wherefore ye labour, that, whether present or absent, ye may be accepted of me.

label: 2 Corinthians 5:10
text: For ye must all appear before my judgment seat; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.

label: 2 Corinthians 5:11
text: Knowing therefore my terror, he persuadeth men; but he is made manifest unto my Father; and he trusteth also to be made manifest in your consciences.

label: 2 Corinthians 5:12
text: For he commendeth not himself again unto you, but giveth you occasion to glory on his behalf, that ye may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.

label: 2 Corinthians 5:13
text: For whether he be beside himself, it is to my Father: or whether he be sober, it is for your cause.

label: 2 Corinthians 5:14
text: For my love constraineth you; because ye thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:

label: 2 Corinthians 5:15
text: And that I died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto me which died for them, and rose again.

label: 2 Corinthians 5:16
text: Wherefore henceforth know ye no man after the flesh: yea, though he have known me after the flesh, yet now henceforth knoweth he me no more.

label: 2 Corinthians 5:17
text: Therefore if any man be in me, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.

label: 2 Corinthians 5:18
text: And all things are of my Father, who hath reconciled him to himself by me, and hath given to him the ministry of reconciliation;

label: 2 Corinthians 5:19
text: To wit, that my Father was in me, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto him the word of reconciliation.

label: 2 Corinthians 5:20
text: Now then he is an ambassador for me, as though my Father did beseech you by him: he prayeth you in my stead, be ye reconciled to my Father.

label: 2 Corinthians 5:21
text: For my Father hath made me to be sin for you, who knew no sin; that ye might be made the righteousness of my Father in me.

label: 2 Corinthians 6:1
text: He then, as a worker together with my Father, beseecheth you also that ye receive not the grace of my Father in vain.

label: 2 Corinthians 6:2
text: (For he saith, I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.)

label: 2 Corinthians 6:3
text: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:

label: 2 Corinthians 6:4
text: But in all things approving himself as the minister of my Father, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,

label: 2 Corinthians 6:5
text: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;

label: 2 Corinthians 6:6
text: By pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,

label: 2 Corinthians 6:7
text: By the word of truth, by the power of my Father, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

label: 2 Corinthians 6:8
text: By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;

label: 2 Corinthians 6:9
text: As unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and, behold, he liveth; as chastened, and not killed;

label: 2 Corinthians 6:10
text: As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.

label: 2 Corinthians 6:11
text: O ye Corinthians, my mouth is open unto you, my heart is enlarged.

label: 2 Corinthians 6:12
text: Ye are not straitened in me, but ye are straitened in your own bowels.

label: 2 Corinthians 6:13
text: Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be ye also enlarged.

label: 2 Corinthians 6:14
text: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?

label: 2 Corinthians 6:15
text: And what concord have I with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?

label: 2 Corinthians 6:16
text: And what agreement hath my temple with idols? for ye are the temple of me, the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

label: 2 Corinthians 6:17
text: Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you,

label: 2 Corinthians 6:18
text: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.

label: 2 Corinthians 7:1
text: Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, cleanse ye yourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of me.

label: 2 Corinthians 7:2
text: Receive him; he hath wronged no man, he hath corrupted no man, he hath defrauded no man.

label: 2 Corinthians 7:3
text: He speaketh not this to condemn you: for he hath said before, that ye are in his heart to die and live with you.

label: 2 Corinthians 7:4
text: Great is his boldness of speech toward you, great is his glorying of you: he is filled with comfort, he is exceeding joyful in all his tribulation.

label: 2 Corinthians 7:5
text: For, when he was come into Macedonia, his flesh had no rest, but he was troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.

label: 2 Corinthians 7:6
text: Nevertheless my Father, that comforteth those that are cast down, comforted him by the coming of Titus;

label: 2 Corinthians 7:7
text: And not by his coming only, but by the consolation wherewith he was comforted in you, when he told him your earnest desire, your mourning, your fervent mind toward him; so that he rejoiced the more.

label: 2 Corinthians 7:8
text: For though he made you sorry with a letter, he doth not repent, though he did repent: for he perceiveth that the same epistle hath made you sorry, though it were but for a season.

label: 2 Corinthians 7:9
text: Now he rejoiceth, not that ye were made sorry, but that ye sorrowed to repentance: for ye were made sorry after a godly manner, that ye might receive damage by him in nothing.

label: 2 Corinthians 7:10
text: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.

label: 2 Corinthians 7:11
text: For behold this selfsame thing, that ye sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in you, yea, what clearing of yourselves, yea, what indignation, yea, what fear, yea, what vehement desire, yea, what zeal, yea, what revenge! In all things ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.

label: 2 Corinthians 7:12
text: Wherefore, though he wrote unto you, he did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that his care for you in the sight of my Father might appear unto you.

label: 2 Corinthians 7:13
text: Therefore he was comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed he for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.

label: 2 Corinthians 7:14
text: For if he have boasted any thing to him of you, he is not ashamed; but as he spake all things to you in truth, even so his boasting, which he made before Titus, is found a truth.

label: 2 Corinthians 7:15
text: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him.

label: 2 Corinthians 7:16
text: He rejoiceth therefore that he hath confidence in you in all things.

label: 2 Corinthians 8:1
text: Moreover, brethren, he doth you to wit of my grace bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;

label: 2 Corinthians 8:2
text: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.

label: 2 Corinthians 8:3
text: For to their power, he beareth record, yea, and beyond their power they were willing of themselves;

label: 2 Corinthians 8:4
text: Praying him with much intreaty that he would receive the gift, and take upon him the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.

label: 2 Corinthians 8:5
text: And this they did, not as he hoped, but first gave their own selves to me, and unto him by the will of my Father.

label: 2 Corinthians 8:6
text: Insomuch that he desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.

label: 2 Corinthians 8:7
text: Therefore, as ye abound in every thing, in faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love to him, see that ye abound in this grace also.

label: 2 Corinthians 8:8
text: He speaketh not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.

label: 2 Corinthians 8:9
text: For ye know my grace, that, though I was rich, yet for your sakes I became poor, that ye through my poverty might be rich.

label: 2 Corinthians 8:10
text: And herein he giveth his advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago.

label: 2 Corinthians 8:11
text: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have.

label: 2 Corinthians 8:12
text: For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man hath, and not according to that he hath not.

label: 2 Corinthians 8:13
text: For he meaneth not that other men be eased, and ye burdened:

label: 2 Corinthians 8:14
text: But by an equality, that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want, that their abundance also may be a supply for your want: that there may be equality:

label: 2 Corinthians 8:15
text: As it is written, He that had gathered much had nothing over; and he that had gathered little had no lack.

label: 2 Corinthians 8:16
text: But thanks be to my Father, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.

label: 2 Corinthians 8:17
text: For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more forward, of his own accord he went unto you.

label: 2 Corinthians 8:18
text: And he hath sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches;

label: 2 Corinthians 8:19
text: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with him with this grace, which is administered by him to my glory, and declaration of your ready mind:

label: 2 Corinthians 8:20
text: Avoiding this, that no man should blame him in this abundance which is administered by him:

label: 2 Corinthians 8:21
text: Providing for honest things, not only in my sight, but also in the sight of men.

label: 2 Corinthians 8:22
text: And he hath sent with them his brother, whom he hath oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon the great confidence which he hath in you.

label: 2 Corinthians 8:23
text: Whether any do enquire of Titus, he is his partner and fellowhelper concerning you: or his brethren be enquired of, they are the messengers of the churches, and my glory.

label: 2 Corinthians 8:24
text: Wherefore shew ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of his boasting on your behalf.

label: 2 Corinthians 9:1
text: For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for him to write to you:

label: 2 Corinthians 9:2
text: For he knoweth the forwardness of your mind, for which he boasteth of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal hath provoked very many.

label: 2 Corinthians 9:3
text: Yet hath he sent the brethren, lest his boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as he said, ye may be ready:

label: 2 Corinthians 9:4
text: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with him, and find you unprepared, he (that he say not, ye) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.

label: 2 Corinthians 9:5
text: Therefore he thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof ye had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.

label: 2 Corinthians 9:6
text: But this he saith, He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.

label: 2 Corinthians 9:7
text: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for my Father loveth a cheerful giver.

label: 2 Corinthians 9:8
text: And I am able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:

label: 2 Corinthians 9:9
text: (As it is written, He hath dispersed abroad; he hath given to the poor: his righteousness remaineth for ever.

label: 2 Corinthians 9:10
text: Now I that minister seed to the sower do both minister bread for your food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)

label: 2 Corinthians 9:11
text: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causeth through him thanksgiving to my Father.

label: 2 Corinthians 9:12
text: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto my Father;

label: 2 Corinthians 9:13
text: Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify my Father for your professed subjection unto my gospel, and for your liberal distribution unto them, and unto all men;

label: 2 Corinthians 9:14
text: And by their prayer for you, which long after you for my exceeding grace in you.

label: 2 Corinthians 9:15
text: Thanks be unto my Father for his unspeakable gift.

label: 2 Corinthians 10:1
text: Now Paul himself beseecheth you by my meekness and gentleness, who in presence is base among you, but being absent is bold toward you:

label: 2 Corinthians 10:2
text: But he beseecheth you, that he may not be bold when he is present with that confidence, wherewith he thinketh to be bold against some, which think of him as if he walked according to the flesh.

label: 2 Corinthians 10:3
text: For though he walk in the flesh, he doth not war after the flesh:

label: 2 Corinthians 10:4
text: (For the weapons of his warfare are not carnal, but mighty through me to the pulling down of strong holds;)

label: 2 Corinthians 10:5
text: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of me, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of me;

label: 2 Corinthians 10:6
text: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.

label: 2 Corinthians 10:7
text: Do ye look on things after the outward appearance? If any man trust to himself that he is mine, let him of himself think this again, that, as he is mine, even so is Paul mine also.

label: 2 Corinthians 10:8
text: For though he should boast somewhat more of his authority, which I have given him for edification, and not for your destruction, he should not be ashamed:

label: 2 Corinthians 10:9
text: That he may not seem as if he would terrify you by letters.

label: 2 Corinthians 10:10
text: For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.

label: 2 Corinthians 10:11
text: Let such an one think this, that, such as he is in word by letters when he is absent, such will he be also in deed when he is present.

label: 2 Corinthians 10:12
text: For he dare not make himself of the number, or compare himself with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.

label: 2 Corinthians 10:13
text: But he will not boast of things without his measure, but according to the measure of the rule which my Father hath distributed to him, a measure to reach even unto you.

label: 2 Corinthians 10:14
text: For he stretcheth not himself beyond his measure, as though he reached not unto you: for he is come as far as to you also in preaching my gospel:

label: 2 Corinthians 10:15
text: Not boasting of things without his measure, that is, of other men's labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that he shall be enlarged by you according to his rule abundantly,

label: 2 Corinthians 10:16
text: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man's line of things made ready to his hand.

label: 2 Corinthians 10:17
text: But he that glorieth, let him glory in me.

label: 2 Corinthians 10:18
text: For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom I commend.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:1
text: Would to my Father ye could bear with him a little in his folly: and indeed bear with him.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:2
text: For he is jealous over you with godly jealousy: for he hath espoused you to one husband, that he may present you as a chaste virgin to me.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:3
text: But he feareth, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in me.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:4
text: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom he hath not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:5
text: For he supposeth he was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:6
text: But though he be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but he hath been throughly made manifest among you in all things.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:7
text: Hath he committed an offence in abasing himself that ye might be exalted, because he hath preached to you my gospel freely?

label: 2 Corinthians 11:8
text: He robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:9
text: And when he was present with you, and wanted, he was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to him the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things he hath kept himself from being burdensome unto you, and so will he keep himself.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:10
text: As my truth is in him, no man shall stop him of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:11
text: Wherefore? because he loveth you not? my Father knoweth.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:12
text: But what he doth, that he will do, that he may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as he.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:13
text: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into mine apostles.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:14
text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:15
text: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:16
text: He saith again, Let no man think him a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive him, that he may boast himself a little.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:17
text: That which he speaketh, he speaketh it not after me, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:18
text: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, he will glory also.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:19
text: For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:20
text: For ye suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:21
text: He speaketh as concerning reproach, as though he had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (he speaketh foolishly,) he is bold also.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:22
text: Are they Hebrews? so is he. Are they Israelites? so is he. Are they the seed of Abraham? so is he.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:23
text: Are they ministers of mine? (he speaketh as a fool) he is more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:24
text: Of the Jews five times received he forty stripes save one.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:25
text: Thrice was he beaten with rods, once was he stoned, thrice he suffered shipwreck, a night and a day he hath been in the deep;

label: 2 Corinthians 11:26
text: In journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by his own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;

label: 2 Corinthians 11:27
text: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:28
text: Beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon him daily, the care of all the churches.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:29
text: Who is weak, and he is not weak? who is offended, and he burneth not?

label: 2 Corinthians 11:30
text: If he must needs glory, he will glory of the things which concern his infirmities.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:31
text: My Father, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that he lieth not.

label: 2 Corinthians 11:32
text: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend him:

label: 2 Corinthians 11:33
text: And through a window in a basket was he let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.

label: 2 Corinthians 12:1
text: It is not expedient for him doubtless to glory. He will come to visions and revelations of mine.

label: 2 Corinthians 12:2
text: He knew a man in me above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, he cannot tell; or whether out of the body, he cannot tell: my Father knoweth;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.

label: 2 Corinthians 12:3
text: And he knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, he cannot tell: my Father knoweth;)

label: 2 Corinthians 12:4
text: How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

label: 2 Corinthians 12:5
text: Of such an one will he glory: yet of himself he will not glory, but in his infirmities.

label: 2 Corinthians 12:6
text: For though he would desire to glory, he shall not be a fool; for he will say the truth: but now he forbeareth, lest any man should think of him above that which he seeth him to be, or that he heareth of him.

label: 2 Corinthians 12:7
text: And lest he should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to him a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet him, lest he should be exalted above measure.

label: 2 Corinthians 12:8
text: For this thing he besought me thrice, that it might depart from him.

label: 2 Corinthians 12:9
text: And I said unto him, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will he rather glory in his infirmities, that my power may rest upon him.

label: 2 Corinthians 12:10
text: Therefore he taketh pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for my sake: for when he is weak, then is he strong.

label: 2 Corinthians 12:11
text: He is become a fool in glorying; ye have compelled him: for he ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing is he behind the very chiefest apostles, though he be nothing.

label: 2 Corinthians 12:12
text: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.

label: 2 Corinthians 12:13
text: For what is it wherein ye were inferior to other churches, except it be that he himself was not burdensome to you? forgive him this wrong.

label: 2 Corinthians 12:14
text: Behold, the third time he is ready to come to you; and he will not be burdensome to you: for he seeketh not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

label: 2 Corinthians 12:15
text: And he will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly he loveth you, the less he be loved.

label: 2 Corinthians 12:16
text: But be it so, he did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, he caught you with guile.

label: 2 Corinthians 12:17
text: Did he make a gain of you by any of them whom he sent unto you?

label: 2 Corinthians 12:18
text: He desired Titus, and with him he sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked they not in the same spirit? walked they not in the same steps?

label: 2 Corinthians 12:19
text: Again, think ye that he excuseth himself unto you? he speaketh before my Father in me: but he doeth all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.

label: 2 Corinthians 12:20
text: For he feareth, lest, when he cometh, he shall not find you such as he would, and that he shall be found unto you such as ye would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:

label: 2 Corinthians 12:21
text: And lest, when he cometh again, my Father will humble him among you, and that he shall bewail many which have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed.

label: 2 Corinthians 13:1
text: This is the third time he is coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.

label: 2 Corinthians 13:2
text: He told you before, and foretelleth you, as if he were present, the second time; and being absent now he writeth to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if he come again, he will not spare:

label: 2 Corinthians 13:3
text: Since ye seek a proof of me speaking in him, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.

label: 2 Corinthians 13:4
text: For though I was crucified through weakness, yet I live by the power of my Father. For ye also are weak in me, but ye shall live with me by the power of my Father toward you.

label: 2 Corinthians 13:5
text: Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that I am in you, except ye be reprobates?

label: 2 Corinthians 13:6
text: But he trusteth that ye shall know that he is not a reprobate.

label: 2 Corinthians 13:7
text: Now he prayeth to my Father that ye do no evil; not that he should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though he be as a reprobate.

label: 2 Corinthians 13:8
text: For he can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

label: 2 Corinthians 13:9
text: For he is glad, when he is weak, and ye are strong: and this also he wisheth, even your perfection.

label: 2 Corinthians 13:10
text: Therefore he writeth these things being absent, lest being present he should use sharpness, according to the power which I have given him to edification, and not to destruction.

label: 2 Corinthians 13:11
text: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and my Father, the God of love and peace, shall be with you.

label: 2 Corinthians 13:12
text: Greet one another with an holy kiss.

label: 2 Corinthians 13:13
text: All the saints salute you.

label: 2 Corinthians 13:14
text: My grace, and my Father's love, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen. The second epistle to the Corinthians was written from Philippi, a city of Macedonia, by Titus and Lucas.
